title: On the Ultraviolet Problem for the Ground State Energy of the Translation-Invariant Pauli--Fierz Model at Zero Total Momentum
summary: We study the ground state energy of the Pauli--Fierz model in the absence of external potentials. We consider the fiber decomposition of the Pauli--Fierz operator with respect to the spectral values, $p$, of the total momentum operator and focus on the case $p = 0$. The corresponding variational problem is analyzed to estimate the dependence of the ground state energy on the ultraviolet cutoff $Λ$.
